title: Knowledge & Skills browser (incl. business-models pack + what was learned)
body:
## Original (as captured)
Dashboard counterpart for the pipeline-phases program.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0119)
A curated business knowledge pack the business agents REFER to: business model canvases, revenue & pricing models, unit-economics formulas, GTM playbooks, growth loops, market-sizing methods, competition frameworks. If a needed model/skill is absent, dynamically research the net and build/register it (ties to forge:dynamic-knowledge-acquisition). Include source + versioning + a staleness/refresh check.
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).
